goal: Falsify and then independently check a transportable C3 refinement-certificate object without allowing the certificate, producer assertions, or one checker to become new authority. The certificate is a commitment to verifier-rederived facts, not a source of those facts.

candidate_wire.authority_rule: Every field other than wire/kind/version is diagnostic transport until independently rederived. No boolean agreement, complete, closed, safe, preservation, authority, reviewer, or producer verdict field is admitted.

id_transcript.netstring: ASCII byte length + ':' + exact UTF-8 bytes + ','
id_transcript.relation: projected_realize is a mathematical set of canonical (world,consequence) pairs; transcript sorts pairs lexicographically and rejects duplicates
order: ASCII('R') || netstring(pair_count) || for sorted pair: ASCII('r') || netstring(world) || netstring(consequence)

w10.role: strictly parse certificate independently; execute frozen W7 and W8 as separate subprocesses; compare independently generated exact C2 bytes; derive a fresh C2 W0 certificate from rederived relation/artifact; execute frozen W5 and W6; recompute C3 certificate transcript without importing W11

w11.role: independently parse/validate certificate and recompute its transcript; orchestrate the same frozen W7/W8/W5/W6 evidence chain without importing or invoking W10; independently construct the C2 W0 certificate transcript/object

independent_checker_plan.subprocess_rule: W10/W11 may invoke the already-frozen semantic checkers as evidence engines but may not trust producer-supplied checker outputs or precomputed agreement flags.
independent_checker_plan.exact_bytes_rule: Supplied C2 program and artifact bytes must be byte-identical to both W7- and W8-generated outputs before downstream checking.
independent_checker_plan.implementation_pins: Hosted gate must pin W7/W8/W5/W6 exact Git blob identities from the R0 science anchor before either certificate checker runs.

derived_chain: read claim, exact C3 profile bytes, candidate C3 certificate bytes, exact C2 program bytes, exact C2 artifact bytes
W7 and W8 independently rederive c3_source_id, semantic_id, graph_id, ordered trace_map_id, projected REALIZE, CBTNF bytes, artifact bytes, target_id
require all corresponding W7/W8 facts equal and require supplied program/artifact bytes equal both independent outputs exactly
construct a fresh C2 W0 preservation certificate from the independently rederived relation and exact artifact; producer C2 certificate input is forbidden
W5 and W6 independently reexecute exact program over exact finite boundary and require exact relation/target/certificate agreement
only after the full chain succeeds compare every transported C3 certificate field to rederived values and recompute c3 certificate_id
require W10 and W11 to reach the same verdict and independently recomputed certificate_id

stale semantic id after semantic profile change

anti_gaming: A negative vector passes only at its intended binding/cross-check plane; accidental parser failure does not count unless the vector targets parsing.
No implementation may rewrite the frozen attack meaning after seeing W10/W11 results. Defects require numbered amendments preserving the prior record.
The candidate certificate is never accepted merely because its internal fields are mutually self-consistent.
No certificate field can substitute for direct execution/reconstruction by the evidence chain.
A valid smaller C2 proof does not establish preservation of a larger C3 source scope.
promotion_floor: all frozen negative vectors rejected by both W10 and W11 at the intended plane
all frozen positive controls accepted by both
W10/W11 independently recompute identical certificate_id and C2 certificate_id
F0 62/62, G1 science anchor, and R0 exhaustive reference anchor remain untouched and green
hosted CI pins all preexisting checker blobs before running
nonclaims: C0 does not create k1.mediated-refinement/v1 production authority.
C0 does not prove W7/W8 universally correct or eliminate all common-mode bugs.
C0 does not bind arbitrary native programs, containers, networks, concurrency, ambient capabilities, or unbounded liveness.
C0 does not make producer-supplied certificate facts authoritative.
C0 does not change K1 semantics or qualified C2.
